trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the last trophy you will earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are all done, so there is nothing extra to do for it. No online play and no DLC are needed, and the whole set is a single-player job. PowerPyx rates the run 4 out of 10 and about 200 hours, with the 100% checklist as the longest grind — Push Square puts the same run at up to 300 hours or more, so budget 200–300. GameTrek is the outlier on difficulty: 7 out of 10, blaming the drone time trials and races.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story and work through the checklist. The good news: the checklist is lenient — it is closer to 60% of everything in the game. Most categories are partial, but some need everything: the robberies (all 39 Illegal Gang Operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults), all 33 underwater discoveries, all 42 shooting-range gold medals, all 42 drone time trials and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. Everything else is partial: 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 15 of 18 meditations. Budget about 100 hours for this stage, and expect it to be the longest part of the run.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 stunts across Leonida — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife-edge flights and base jumps all count, and you can mix them however you like. There are 397 stunts in the game, so you do not need anywhere near all of them. Stunts you do naturally while driving and flying count too, so keep an eye on the counter in Progress and clean up the remainder with jumps near Vice City.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. Eight of the nine need only one attempt, not a win — but the race must actually be won, so this is still a quick tour rather than a grind. Do it early — every activity you sample also feeds other trophies, and several of them are required in full for 100% completion.

The strand opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: Bret texts you, the first quest is Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret) in Lummox County, and hunting spots show as purple icons. The first quest gives you the rifle Killtelligence SM-69 — if you lose it, Ammu-Nations stock it. Track the decks under Map > Activities > Target Deck. The exact animal that unlocks the strand is still being confirmed, so do not rely on a specific animal name; the questline mechanics above are what the sources verify.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Play as Jason, from Chapter 2 onward — Bret's strand is Jason-only; it opens after Coffee Break.
Answer Bret's text and do the first quest, Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret) in Lummox County.
Follow the purple hunting-spot icons and work through Bret's Target Decks — 15 in total, also required in full for the 100% checklist.
The first quest gives you the rifle Killtelligence SM-69 — if you lose it, Ammu-Nations stock it.
damnmodz reports the first target is the Snapmatic Buck, hunted at night north-east of Grayson — then have Bret collect it. Single-source report, not yet confirmed.
Track the decks under Map > Activities > Target Deck.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in the game, so pick the 3 whose cards you find first — cards turn up in shops, out in the world and as rewards, and a set completes when you hold every card in it. The 100% checklist wants 15 of 18, so keep collecting after the trophy pops.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: There are 18 card sets in the game; you need any 3 complete sets for this trophy.
Track your sets under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.
A set completes when you hold every card in it — stop at 3 unless you are chasing 100%.
Cards you sell at Pawn Shops still count toward your progress, so selling duplicates is safe.
Going for 100%? The checklist needs 15 of the 18 sets — this trophy pops on the way.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the WAiNK app: hold Up, look at the thing, then hold R1 to scan it. Any 100 count — 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and No Flusher Tags are the pools the game draws from, so you don't have to complete any single set. The same app scans the 200 base-model vehicles the checklist wants, so scan every vehicle you meet too.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps.text: Open the WAiNK app on your phone — hold Up to open it instantly.
Scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags.
Hold Up, then hold R1 on a highlighted object to scan it.
Scan everything new as you travel — any 100 scans count, you don't need all of them.
Check your total under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.
Scan every vehicle you meet too — the same app scans the 200 base-model vehicles the checklist wants.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges — the 100% checklist wants 70, so this trophy is the halfway mark. Track them under Progress > Challenges. The challenges span combat, driving, robbery and more, so most of them finish themselves while you chase the other trophies; pick up the stragglers in cleanup.

The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so this trophy is the halfway mark.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

risk.window: After Chapter 2 — Coffee Break (duo free-roam unlocks)
risk.lastChance: None — also pops automatically during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…
risk.protect: Call your partner (hold Right + Triangle) before building 4 stars

trophies.guide: Escape a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you. The earliest you can do it is after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when duo free-roam opens: call your partner (hold Right + Triangle), build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and leave the red heat zone — the trophy pops as you leave it. A fast sports motorcycle is the easiest escape vehicle, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a good place to break line of sight. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), so if you miss the free-roam version, the mission hands it to you.

Escape on a fast sports motorcycle; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County) breaks line of sight.
The trophy pops after leaving the red heat zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.target: 3 shops in a row, with partner

risk.protect: Stay wanted between shops; rob a couple of items in each store and crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs; if it doesn't pop after the 3rd, hit a 4th

Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs (Ammu-Nations) and Zombix or Adrenaline, and call your partner. The trophy pops about 30 seconds after you leave the third shop; if it hasn't unlocked, hit a fourth. The best spot is three Jewelry Stores north of Vice City, open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — loot the items and crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles with the WAiNK app — hold Up, look at the vehicle, then hold R1. There are 557 vehicles at launch, so scan every new vehicle you meet from the start rather than hunting them at the end. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this trophy pops well before the checklist is done. Check progress under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

risk.window: Any fight once Combat Focus is unlocked
risk.protect: Raise Focus to Level 4 first — it makes the window much easier (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots). Fight gang members at illegal operations; soldiers, police and civilians don't seem to count

trophies.guide: Incapacitate 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Aim and press L3+R3 — time slows and weak spots are highlighted, but the purple focus bar drains, so line the enemies up first. Buff the bar with food, drinks, washing your face or showering, and extend it with Adrenaline (hold L1 + Triangle). Gang Operations are the reliable place to find five armed enemies together; use the Duke 556 assault rifle and body armor. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has four levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus, purple eye), raised through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA — not one of the airfield planes — and fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away. The easiest terminals are E3 and E4: drive through the fence, take the stairs by the boarding bridge into the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip and take off. The unlock is delayed, so keep flying until it pops.

Go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip and take off.
Fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away from VCIA — the unlock is delayed, so keep flying until it pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of Mariana County. The tanks sit south of the base: drive through the gate or stunt-jump in at the south-east entrance, get in a tank and shoot your way out. Bring body armor and expect heavy resistance — the base is fully armed.

Get in a tank and shoot your way out; bring body armor.
If the trophy does not pop, fire the cannon.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

risk.protect: Use the Snap Gun on the back door; kicking it triggers the alarm

trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without alerting the guards. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — that unlocks the Snap Gun (permanent, no equip needed) and Jewelry Store Robberies (green icons in unfogged areas). Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun — kicking the door triggers the alarm — and read the backroom note for the safe code. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot.

Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun — kicking the door triggers the alarm.
Read the backroom note for the safe code, then rob the store without alerting the guards.
Inside, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm before looting.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults and escape each time. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): tail the security van to the bank, the guard carries the briefcase, the vault opens and you rob it. Bring your partner (hold Right to hand off a bag), expect a 4-star wanted level on the vault robbery, and escape by fast motorcycle, then switch vehicle. After the quest, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips — he offers them after his earlier quests (robbing 2 Payday Loans). There are 8 Large Bank Jobs in total and the trophy needs 5 of them (all 8 for 100%); a vault can pay up to $205,000 in one robbery.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

After the vault is open, escape the red heat or use a Pay 'n' Spray.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.target: Smash out of a vehicle showroom

It only works after the Key Cloner in Chapter 3, unlocked by the main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy): hack in, then drive forward straight through the window. Only the blue Banshee counts, not any other car — and the trophy pops with a delay, so keep driving further away after the smash.

The valuables: a luxury watch in the south-east office (golden icon), the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the north-east corner table (golden icon), and a safe in the north-east hallway — blow it up with Sticky Bombs. The robbery is not missable: the icon respawns after a long time if you leave it.

You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

risk.window: Whole game — the profile builds as you play
risk.protect: Avoid the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent and police shoot on sight more. The profiles run Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable — turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications) to see which actions count

trophies.guide: Raise your criminal profile by 500 actions. View the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list, and turn on notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) so you see the demon face on the right of the screen. The profiles run Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable — and they are permanent: excessive violence only ever raises the profile. It comes naturally over a full playthrough; if you need to farm it, running over civilians and cops with a car is the fastest way. Watch out: at Psycho and Irredeemable, cops are more likely to shoot on sight.

It opens after the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer. The store is the Payday Loans in Vice City, Little Cuba: aim your weapon at the teller, take out the security that shoots at you, break through the door and empty all 3 cash drawers — then get away on foot, not in a vehicle. The unlock is delayed: escape the police search area and run far enough before it pops.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg: after Chapter 1, go to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night, after 2 AM, alone. The spawn is slightly random — sometimes a blinking car waits at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO, a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it and the UFO drops the woman it abducted: talk to her, offer to help, and she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy unlocks — the chain continues toward Area 51.
